statusDefinitions.satisfied: Existing evidence is executable or reviewable and may be cited now.
statusDefinitions.partial: Useful evidence exists, but the slice-specific contract is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.missing: The evidence must be created in the stated phase.
statusDefinitions.blocked: External, human, governed-data, or live-environment input is required.
statusDefinitions.conditional: Required only if the approved design chooses the applicable replacement or migration path.
statusDefinitions.not_applicable: The evidence category does not apply to this slice.

globalItems.note: A generated hash-backed audit and locked-dependency inventory now match the clean integration candidate. Human review and an exact-start freeze after prerequisite integration are still required before a slice starts.

@types/node is aligned with Node 22 and the setup runs in a dedicated codex/refactor-* worktree. The lockfile contains 531 locations while the policy says 530; repository history shows the security-mandated @humanfs/types location existed before the policy was created, so a human must either adopt a reviewed 531-location exception or direct a supported dependency reduction. Stale worktrees with unique commits also require explicit disposition.

A reviewed per-function baseline exists. The clean integration candidate has 272 hotspots versus 271, no increase in critical hotspots, one additional control-plane hotspot, and 11 exact inherited function failures. The characterization runner's new hotspot was removed rather than added to the baseline. Begin a slice only after the named owners and independent reviewer approve the exact-commit non-regression proposal or the prerequisite functions are repaired; never regenerate the baseline to absorb them.

A repository-owner CODEOWNERS route exists, but there is no independent backup/reviewer and main currently requires zero approvals, does not require code-owner review, and permits administrator bypass. Name the independent reviewer path and enforce the reviewed branch-protection checks before a slice starts.

The guarded cloud controller dispatches focused and independent checks, but main protection currently requires only the verify job and ordinary pull requests do not run the browser, operational, or PostgreSQL jobs. Define and enforce the commit-attached required-check set for refactor pull requests before implementation.

The baseline generator records separate complexity, churn, fan-in, dependency, branch-depth, duplication, control-plane, and planned-slice signals without collapsing them into a correctness score. A clean candidate run identifies referral-store.ts as the top critical-review target with four overlapping hotspot rankings, but human review and a fresh run from the final exact approved starting commit remain required.
The process explicitly permits only bounded candidate-commit claims and prohibits whole-application bug-free, perfect, or unqualified formal-verification claims.

The evaluation harness and public calibration suite are agent-drafted bootstrap candidates. Before any slice starts, humans must validate the scenarios and anti-patterns, run matched first-attempt baseline/candidate trials with blind review and private holdouts, keep an exact-commit guidance bundle, and record the adopted comparison. Passing the structural checker alone is not adoption evidence.

items.note: Existing rules are strong; freeze representative return values, audit events, database effects, and errors before moving code. Owner purpose statement recorded verbatim on 2026-09-06: "accomplish gathering the full profile for eventual admission, and with the assessment, make that decision, generally only one person will touch the referral from start to finish, there are a few that will be assigned referral but will only do the assessment and hopefully wotn need to change the workspace creation part". Owner role direction recorded 2026-09-06: most referral owners carry the workspace from creation through the decision process; two assessors generally receive assignments and also create their own workspaces; one assessment-only assessor receives assigned work and ordinarily changes only assessment information; verified profile corrections by that assessor are permitted and attributable. Workspace ownership, visible history, field-aware saves, name-plus-county human duplicate review, and referral-to-open-assessment reassignment are now executable product prerequisites on the clean integration candidate. The reassignment scenario exposed and then verified a narrow PostgreSQL parameter-typing repair. Machine observations cover these referral-store seams, but human review of the complete architecture narrative and exact-start evidence remains required.

The same clean-commit synthetic API characterization passes against isolated local-file and disposable PostgreSQL 16 stores for create replay, disjoint and conflicting section writes, denied mutations, duplicate packet rejection, duplicate-person review, referral-to-open-assessment reassignment, trash, restore, access changes, and audit cardinality. The handoff scenario first exposed a PostgreSQL parameter-typing defect and then passed 6/6 on both adapters after the narrow repair. Human review must still approve the observable contract and identify missing domain or PostgreSQL-only transaction cases before this item can be satisfied.

Clean-commit executable evidence freezes create replay with a changed replay payload, disjoint section success, same-section one-winner conflict behavior, exact-set duplicate confirmation, stale trash and restore rejection, audit cardinality, and the 30-day restore deadline on both adapters. Human owner review, direct database-effect review, and any missing command-specific concurrency cases remain required before this item can be satisfied.

Static route coverage and clean-commit executed allow and deny evidence cover create, patch, trash, restore, and duplicate confirmation across local-file and PostgreSQL adapters, including anonymous, read-only, wrong-resource, cross-origin, hidden-candidate, and guessed-id denial with no side effects. Human review must still validate coverage against the final allowed file audit and any additional mutation entry points before completion.
The platform baseline exists; rerun the store profile against the approved slice and review query-plan deltas.
